passive.project_cradle.fire: Fire: techniques ignite their targets, and projectile impacts can start fires.
passive.project_cradle.air: Air: H toggles upright flight. WASD moves level; Space rises, Shift descends, and holding sprint boosts. Release controls to hover.
passive.project_cradle.light: Light: creatures struck by techniques glow.
passive.project_cradle.dream: Dream: offensive technique hits cause nausea and briefly prevent the target attacking you.
passive.project_cradle.destruction: Destruction: your projectiles break the block they hit, respecting protected and unbreakable blocks.
passive.project_cradle.force: Force: your hits deliver extra knockback.
passive.project_cradle.sword: Sword: gain 3 attack damage, equivalent to Strength I.
passive.project_cradle.hunger: Hunger: recover 20% of health damage dealt, up to 1 heart per hit.
message.project_cradle.flight_requires_a: Air flight requires Lowgold with Air madra or Monarch advancement, while awake, unmounted, outside water/lava, and not gliding.
message.project_cradle.air_flight_starte: Air flight: H to stop; WASD moves level; Space up; Shift down; hold sprint (default Ctrl) to boost. Release controls to hover.
message.project_cradle.air_flight_landin: Descending gently to a safe landing. Press H to resume Air flight.
tooltip.project_cradle.shield: Forge a physical barrier that intercepts incoming projectiles and absorbs attacks until it breaks or expires.
tooltip.project_cradle.fireball: Launch a growing fire orb that explodes on impact, burning nearby foes. Its power increases as it travels.
tooltip.project_cradle.ice_lance: Fire a swift lance of ice that pierces up to four foes and slows creatures it damages.
tooltip.project_cradle.chain_lightning: Strike the foe nearest your crosshair, then chain through up to four nearby foes with clear lines of sight.
tooltip.project_cradle.blink: Teleport along your aim, stopping before any obstruction. Base range: eight blocks. Requires room for your whole body.
tooltip.project_cradle.healing_pulse: Restore health to yourself and nearby allied players. Full-health targets receive no extra health.
tooltip.project_cradle.counterspell: Disperse hostile projectiles in a cone ahead of you and interrupt enemies preparing techniques.
tooltip.project_cradle.gravity_well: Create a five-second force vortex at your aim point, pulling nearby foes inward and dealing periodic damage.
